cases.name: Jennifer Elizabeth von Hausen Rothwell
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jennifer was a graduate of Park Hill High School in Kansas City, Mo., and received her Bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri at Columbia. She and Beau Rothwell were married September 26, 2015. She worked as a Process Engineer at the DuPont Chesterfield office in St. Louis, where she made a lot of friends. She enjoyed traveling, playing games with friends and family, and celebrating life. Most importantly, Jennifer loved spending holidays and birthdays with her family. She was a loving daughter, sister, niece, cousin and friend."
cases.narrative: Her nude body was found dumped along Highway 61 in a remote area near Troy, MO. The forensic pathologist said died of “blunt cranial cerebral trauma and was struck in the head at least 3 times. He admitted to beating her to death with a kitchen mallet.
